railBookingHomeAndForwardedSharing202611.retryContext:
On iOS 26.5 the first forwarded-title check after reinstall timed out on a blank system sheet. The first system provider-load message was recorded at the end of that test. With the same installed extension and the same assertions all three final cases passed on retry. On iOS 27.0 the public homepage, forwarded details and rendered receipt passed in the final batch. A separate legacy smoke lost the simulator accessibility connection while tapping the host, before the expected extension result. That case was rerun after restarting the dedicated simulator. The iOS 26.5 app was re-signed with the updated extension: its signature bytes changed, and its unsigned main executable and JS bundle matched the prior normal workspace Release byte for byte. The legacy smoke after the accessibility restart detected a separate regression: SRT image station fields were empty, and its automated manual-correction attempt did not fill the field. A simulator Vision probe read the printed arrow as two chevrons. A later iOS 26 final-product attempt showed the expected login-required screen after the independent API readback had started another session for that test account. The accepted run used regular in-app sign-in.
The shipping SRT image uses the single chevron seen by iOS 26.5 Vision and the double chevron seen by iOS 27.0 Vision when supported by corroborating receipt fields. On the final 26.5 app the compact SRT OCR, station editing and forwarded items passed. The initial public-site retry timed out opening MobileSafari before sharing. On the final 27.0 app the public-site and editing checks passed. The initial compact and forwarded runs timed out while the sheet was respectively still reading or blank. The share selector now waits for the visible NoLate extension to start before the individual content assertions. Intermediate failures are included in the run list.
